minLOD.name: minLOD
minLOD.description: Minimum LOD setting, used with Graphics Option's Particle settings to cull particles.

maxLOD.name: maxLOD
maxLOD.description: Maximum LOD setting, used with Graphics Option's Particle settings to cull particles.

StartDelay.name: StartDelay
StartDelay.description: Time, in seconds, before this render Starts to animate.

lifeTime.name: lifeTime
lifeTime.description: Time in seconds this Render lasts.

maxCount.name: maxCount
maxCount.description: Maximum number of this particle that can be active on the screen at any given time before oldest ones get Culled.

SimulateSoundEffect.name: SimulateSoundEffect
SimulateSoundEffect.description: If specified, this is the sound file played when this particle is emitted.

emitDelay.name: emitDelay
emitDelay.description: Time in seconds between emitting an instance of the Render.

emitDelayVar.name: emitDelayVar
emitDelayVar.description: Maximum variance in the emitDelay for this render. Adds a random between 0.0f and emitDelayVar to emitDelay each time it emits an instance of the Render.

emitPosVariance.name: emitPosVariance
emitPosVariance.description: Maximum random Position variance for this Render's initial starting position from the root position of the emitter Object.

emitVelocity.name: emitVelocity
emitVelocity.description: Maximum random Velocity variance for this Render.

emitVariance.name: emitVariance
emitVariance.description: Maximum random Directional variance for this Render's velocity.

emitInherit.name: emitInherit
emitInherit.description: Percent of Velocity inherited from the root emitter Object's velocity. 1.0 is 100%, but is not limited.

renderCount.name: renderCount
renderCount.description: How many Renders to add. This list is unlimited, try not to over do it.

textureName.name: textureName
textureName.description: Texture filename applied to this Render. File extension does not matter, game internally converts it to .dds.

textureBlend.name: textureBlend
textureBlend.description: Texture Blend mode for the Texture on this Render.

animateTime.name: animateTime
animateTime.description: Time to transition between StartColor / StartRadius, to FinishColor / Radius.

useTerrainColor.name: useTerrainColor
useTerrainColor.description: The Percent value of Terrain cluster color under the Render to blend with the current Color. Valid values are 0.0 to 1.0.

segmentVariance.name: segmentVariance
segmentVariance.description: The X Y Z variance of each segment's direction.

textureRate.name: textureRate
textureRate.description: Rate which the texture can change per segment.

textureSpeed.name: textureSpeed
textureSpeed.description: UV Speed of the Texture along the trail.

geomName.name: geomName
geomName.description: Model file name for this Render. Can be .XSI or .FBX. The TextureName is applied to the uvmapping on the Model, and the textureMode is used on it.

AddPitch.name: AddPitch
AddPitch.description: Amount added to Pitch per second.

AddYaw.name: AddYaw
AddYaw.description: Amount added to Yaw per second.

AddRoll.name: AddRoll
AddRoll.description: Amount added to Roll per second.

ForceDrawTransparent.name: ForceDrawTransparent
ForceDrawTransparent.description: If this is true, it forces it to draw using transparency. If false, draws it opaque.

ForceDraw2Sided.name: ForceDraw2Sided
ForceDraw2Sided.description: If this is true, draws it as a 2 Sided geometry, if false, hides back faces.

lightType.name: lightType
lightType.description: The type of light. Valid values are:

R.name: R
R.defaultRaw: Radius, Kc = Constant, Kl = Linear, Kq = Quadratic. The Blue line represents BZCC's light falloff. BZCC's Shader forces the light to end at 0, which is why the dotted Red line isn't the actual light falloff curve.

coneAngInner.name: coneAngInner
coneAngInner.description: Inner Cone Angle for lightType: spot.

coneAngOuter.name: coneAngOuter
coneAngOuter.description: Outer Cone Angle for lightType: spot.

coneFalloff.name: coneFalloff
coneFalloff.description: Cone Falloff ratio between origin and Radius. Used for lightType: spot.

lensFlare.name: lensFlare
lensFlare.description: If false, doesn't create a Sprite of "lightflare.tga" and "lighthalo.tga" at it's origin.

AddPitch.name: AddPitch
AddPitch.description: Amount added to Pitch per second.

AddYaw.name: AddYaw
AddYaw.description: Amount added to Yaw per second.

AddRoll.name: AddRoll
AddRoll.description: Amount added to Roll per second.

spriteCenter.x.name: spriteCenter.x
spriteCenter.x.description: Offsets the Center position of the Sprite texture on the X Axis. 1.0 is 100%.

spriteCenter.y.name: spriteCenter.y
spriteCenter.y.description: Offsets the Center position of the Sprite texture on the Y Axis. 1.0 is 100%.

emitDelay.name: emitDelay
emitDelay.description: Time in seconds between emitting particles.

emitDelayVar.name: emitDelayVar
emitDelayVar.description: Maximum random variance added to emitDelay.

staticTime.name: staticTime
staticTime.description: Overrides the lifeTime value, if present.

segmentTime.name: segmentTime
segmentTime.description: Overrides the animateTime value, if present.

segmentTime.name: segmentTime
segmentTime.description: Overrides animateTime if specified. Controls how long each Segment takes to render.

textureRate.name: textureRate
textureRate.description: Rate the texture repeats across each segment.

textureSpeed.name: textureSpeed
textureSpeed.description: Speed the UV coordinates move the texture along the Trail.

rotationRate.name: rotationRate
rotationRate.description: Maximum random Rotation that can be applied.

BottomInteractsWithTerrain.name: BottomInteractsWithTerrain
BottomInteractsWithTerrain.description: If true, squishes vertically to avoid clipping through Terrain.

emitInherit.name: emitInherit
emitInherit.description: Percent of Velocity inherited from the root emitter Object's velocity. 1.0 is 100%, but is not limited.

emitLife.name: emitLife
emitLife.description: Time in seconds that each emitted TwirlRender lasts.

maxDist.name: maxDist
maxDist.description: Distance from Camera for it to stop Rendering.

maxRadii.name: maxRadii
maxRadii.description: Radius outside of Camera view for it to skip Rendering.

waveAngle.name: waveAngle
waveAngle.description: Angle of the Wave. Pi is fully circular.

waveColorCenter.name: waveColorCenter
waveColorCenter.description: Color of the wave in the Center.

waveColorEdge.name: waveColorEdge
waveColorEdge.description: Color of the Wave at the Edge.

waveTextureRepeats.name: waveTextureRepeats
waveTextureRepeats.description: If true, repeats the texture for each Segment. If false, applies the texture across the whole Wave.

waveSegments.name: waveSegments
waveSegments.description: Number of Segments in the Wave.
